unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to visitors before entering the center, except overnight staff to whom the registration duty does not apply.
unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must register before entering the center, except overnight staff to whom this registration duty does not apply.
Visitors are not required to wear a badge.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to visitors inside the center, except maintenance workers performing repairs.
unit_attributes.statement: Visitors must not carry metal tools inside the center, except maintenance workers performing repairs.
This policy does not prohibit visitors from carrying paper maps.
Other building policies may impose additional restrictions.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to overnight staff regarding the registration duty in paragraph a.
unit_attributes.statement: The registration duty in paragraph a does not apply to overnight staff.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to maintenance workers performing repairs regarding the metal-tool prohibition in paragraph c.
unit_attributes.statement: The metal-tool prohibition in paragraph c does not apply to maintenance workers performing repairs.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to maintenance workers while performing repairs.
unit_attributes.statement: Maintenance workers may carry metal tools while performing repairs.

unit_attributes.scope_text: When the visitor desk is busy.
unit_attributes.statement: A delay may occur when the visitor desk is busy.

unit_attributes.scope_text: Applies to staff regarding each visitor.
unit_attributes.statement: Staff should record the arrival time of each visitor.
